svg.title: splitbill: Scan a receipt in the browser, split it by item or percentage, and every rupiah still adds up. Short links stay private.
svg.desc: Project card for splitbill, showing real screenshots of the desktop and mobile layouts scrolling. Scan a receipt in the browser, split it by item or percentage, and every rupiah still adds up. Short links stay private. Built with Vue 3, TypeScript, Hono, Drizzle, Tesseract.js.
